# Job It Ready

> Job It Ready is an AI-powered front desk for independent trades businesses — plumbers, electricians, HVAC, and appliance repair. A customer photographs a problem, Job It Ready prices it against the business's own price sheet using Claude AI, and the customer books directly onto the business's calendar. No receptionist, no missed leads, no waiting for a callback. Plans start at $19/month for a solo operator, $39/month for a crew of two to five, with custom pricing for multi-truck, multi-trade shops.

## Access

- **Live demo (no signup):** https://www.jobitready.com/demo
- **Pricing:** https://www.jobitready.com/pricing
- **Start a free trial:** https://www.jobitready.com/signup

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.jobitready.com/): How the product works — photo in, AI-priced estimate out, booked onto the business's own calendar. The problem it solves (missed leads, slow manual quoting) and who it's for.
- [Live demo](https://www.jobitready.com/demo): Try the actual customer-facing quote flow — a real photo gets a real Claude-generated diagnosis and price, no account needed.
- [Pricing](https://www.jobitready.com/pricing): Solo ($19/mo, one person one truck), Crew ($39/mo, two to five techs), and Shop (custom, multi-truck/multi-trade) plans with a full feature comparison.

## What Job It Ready Does

- Turns a customer's photo and a couple of sentences into a priced estimate, off the business's own price sheet, in minutes instead of hours.
- Detects the customer's language automatically and responds in kind (English or Spanish).
- Generates branded proposals, invoices, and receipts as PDF or PNG from the same estimate.
- Gives the business an embeddable widget and a shareable link — the same flow works whether a customer visits their website or gets a link directly.

## What Job It Ready Is Not

Job It Ready is not a full field-service-management suite like Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan — it doesn't do scheduling/dispatch, crew GPS tracking, route optimization, or payment processing for a trade's own customers. It's specifically the AI photo-to-quote front door, meant to complement a business's existing tools (it hands off booking to their existing Cal.com or Calendly link), not replace them.
